Options I see:
- Move the demo to later on Nov 4 (I can do 2:30 PM PT) and we keep the same attendee list; or
- Keep Nov 4 10:00 AM, and I’ll hand off to another SE (Marissa can lead the product demo with me on standby for technical Qs); or
- Reschedule to Nov 5 morning if StackBridge prefers an exec-friendly window.

Connor — thanks for the confirmation. Heads up that our CFO (Alex) had a last-minute travel change and will only be on-site after 1:00 PM PT on Nov 4. Our preferred outcome is to keep Alex on the call for the SLA/cost conversation.

We can do either:
- Nov 4 at 2:30 PM PT (30–45 minutes, focused on SLA + cost), or
- Nov 5 between 9:00–11:00 AM PT if that’s easier.

If you need to swap SEs, that’s fine — we just want someone who can answer Dedicated capacity sizing and failover fallback questions.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Tom Li
VP of Engineering | StackBridge
tom.li@stackbridge.com

Tom — thanks for the quick update and sorry to hear about Alex’s travel shuffle. We can accommodate both options. To keep momentum I propose the following (pick one):

A) Keep Nov 4 but move to 2:30 PM PT (30–45 min). Marissa will run the demo and Karthik will join for the Dedicated sizing + failover deep-dive. I’ve attached a one-page tech brief for a quick handoff.

B) Reschedule to Nov 5 at 9:30 AM PT (60 min) — Karthik can lead and we’ll preserve the full agenda including cost modeling and rollout policies.

If A works, I’ll update the invite and include the condensed agenda so Alex can jump into the SLA/cost section immediately. If B looks better I’ll propose the new calendar time.

Next steps: please reply with A or B (or propose another window). I’ve attached the MAP and a screenshot with our proposed windows to make choosing easier.

Connor O'Brien
